DAIRY HEAT STRESS preliminary web edition
Objective

How heat stress shapes U.S. dairy production

A report-aligned view of yield and milk-fat effects estimated with causal machine learning, together with realized national losses, state exposure, and year-specific evidence from 2003–2025.

Annual monetized loss

Preferred cumulative effects per stress day

How to read this dashboard. Model estimates are pooled causal effects from the 21-state monthly estimation panel. Economic-loss views evaluate those pooled coefficients against realized exposure, production, and prices across the 48 contiguous states; they are not state-specific causal coefficients. Uncertainty ranges are coefficient-sensitivity bands.
Acknowledgements
Partnership

This project brings together The Dairy Alliance and the Department of Agricultural and Applied Economics at Virginia Tech to study climate stress and U.S. dairy production.

Project grant

The Dairy Alliance funded the project.

Research team

Duong Ta, Mario Ortez, Michael Cary, and Bradford Mills.
